name: Extract PDF invoice line items with QuickRouter and validate CSV totals

nodes.name: QuickRouter text request
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential. Name: Authorization. Value: Bearer YOUR_QUICKROUTER_KEY. One text-model request per valid run; API usage may be billed. No automatic retry.

parameters.content:
### How it works
This template helps small-business operators turn a selectable-text PDF invoice into reviewable CSV rows. Manual Trigger starts with an included fictional invoice, so no external sample file is needed. Native PDF extraction provides text for one low-cost QuickRouter text-model request. The workflow validates the returned JSON, checks line amounts and the grand total with integer cents, then exports formula-safe CSV for human review.

### Setup
Use n8n 2.16.0, the tested release, or verify your own version. Get a QuickRouter API key at https://api.quickrouter.ai/console. Create an n8n Header Auth credential: Name Authorization; Value Bearer followed by a space and your key. Select it in QuickRouter text request. Confirm the text-model ID in Sample input is available to your account. Executions use paid API tokens, with an output limit and no automatic retry. Never embed keys in workflow JSON.

### Customization
Run the included sample and inspect both CSV rows first. Replace Create sample PDF with your own file input, keeping binary property data. Check extracted text before calling the model. Scans need separate OCR; taxes, discounts and complex invoice layouts need additional validation. Incorrect or malformed output stops execution. This workflow sends no customer replies or business-system updates.

## Extract the invoice text
Use the included synthetic PDF first. Replace its file-input step for your own invoice, keep binary property data, and inspect extracted text. Scanned PDFs require separate OCR.

## Structure the line items
Select your private Header Auth credential and confirm the low-cost text model. One request structures the extracted invoice. The output limit bounds the response; errors are not retried automatically.

## Validate and export CSV
Reject malformed JSON and inconsistent totals. Review the two sample rows and exported CSV. Integer-cent checks and formula-safe cells help catch invalid or unsafe spreadsheet output; content still needs human review.
